correctness.rationale: For smooth monic deg-5 F over alg closed F5, the stated differential basis has Cartier off-diagonal rank-one blocks indexed by W=(c4,c3,c2) and V=([x4],[x9],[x14])F^3. The semilinear second-iterate scalar has 25th power P=sum W_i^5 V_i, so stable rank is two when P≠0 and zero when P=0. On the smooth locus V vanishes iff W does, yielding a-number 4 on W=0 and 2 elsewhere. As a degree-2 polynomial in c0, P is primitive over F5[c1,c2,c3,c4]; the discriminant at (c4,c3,c2)=(1,0,1) is 4c1^2+3, not a square over the algebraic closure, proving absolute irreducibility. The smooth rank-zero witness has P=0 and nonzero partial derivative. Independent exact polynomial extraction and enumerating all 3125 F5 coefficient tuples reproduced 2500 smooth with (f5,a) counts (2,2)=1800, (0,2)=680, (0,4)=20. Finite enumeration is not the geometric proof.
residual_risks: Irreducibility is in marked coefficient affine space, not an unmarked moduli space; claims require smoothness/separability.
